## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: max_rounds remains a hard ceiling that no judged answer can extend, asserted...

The system SHALL ensure that max_rounds remains a hard ceiling that no judged answer can extend, asserted by a test where the round Noul stays high.

#### Scenario: max_rounds remains a hard ceiling that no judged answer can extend, asserted...

WHEN `route-review-convergence-on-per-finding-dispositions` is implemented
THEN max_rounds remains a hard ceiling that no judged answer can extend, asserted by a test where the round Noul stays high.

### Requirement: A replay over recorded ledger trends shows fewer fix dispatches than the...

The system SHALL ensure that a replay over recorded ledger trends shows fewer fix dispatches than the stall rule for the same terminal blocking count, with both counts recorded.

#### Scenario: A replay over recorded ledger trends shows fewer fix dispatches than the...

WHEN `route-review-convergence-on-per-finding-dispositions` is implemented
THEN A replay over recorded ledger trends shows fewer fix dispatches than the stall rule for the same terminal blocking count, with both counts recorded.

### Requirement: defer_to_followup and reject_out_of_scope go through the existing park_item...

The system SHALL ensure that defer_to_followup and reject_out_of_scope go through the existing park_item and reject_out_of_scope_fix paths, with no new ledger mutation surface.

#### Scenario: defer_to_followup and reject_out_of_scope go through the existing park_item...

WHEN `route-review-convergence-on-per-finding-dispositions` is implemented
THEN defer_to_followup and reject_out_of_scope go through the existing park_item and reject_out_of_scope_fix paths, with no new ledger mutation surface.

### Requirement: needs_human parks the item as a disagreement rather than dispatching a fix,...

The system SHALL ensure that needs_human parks the item as a disagreement rather than dispatching a fix, covered by a test.

#### Scenario: needs_human parks the item as a disagreement rather than dispatching a fix,...

WHEN `route-review-convergence-on-per-finding-dispositions` is implemented
THEN needs_human parks the item as a disagreement rather than dispatching a fix, covered by a test.

### Requirement: With the helper returning None the stall rule trend[-1] >=...

The system SHALL ensure that with the helper returning None the stall rule trend[-1] >= trend[-stall_window] still governs, proven by existing convergence tests passing unchanged.

#### Scenario: With the helper returning None the stall rule trend[-1] >=...

WHEN `route-review-convergence-on-per-finding-dispositions` is implemented
THEN With the helper returning None the stall rule trend[-1] >= trend[-stall_window] still governs, proven by existing convergence tests passing unchanged.
